observed.front: Apr2019 Street View (lot pano 9T6F, h183; ref 1113-nne-front01b, ~38-53 m): stepped long row, maroon doors, grey walled courts beside doors (photo-mapped west of each visible door), regular wide upper windows; siding read blue-grey in 2019.
observed.rear: Nov2025 (BrOH3kQa; ref 1113-ssw-rear02): long white two-storey rear with regular upper windows about two per unit, dishes, tall fence; the 2025 rear reads white, so the present-day palette is a pale neutral (the 2019 front was blue-grey; disclosed). Lower rear storey is production_inference.
